description.fun: Happiny can't lay eggs yet, so it carries a round white stone in its pouch to copy Chansey and Blissey, and treasures it so much that it throws a tantrum if anyone takes it. Sometimes the thing it picks is too big, and it can't move. It loves playing house with children, and its habit of toddling around people's feet trips them up.
description.guide: A small, pink Normal baby Pokémon introduced in Generation 4 that carries an egg-shaped stone in its pouch to imitate Chansey. It is female-only. It evolves into Chansey when levelled up during the day holding an Oval Stone.
description.tagline: A tiny nurse-in-training with a pet rock for an egg

description.fun: Chansey lays several highly nutritious eggs a day and kindly shares them with the injured, but never with anyone evil-hearted, and the eggs taste better the more love it's raised with. So many people chased it for its eggs that it became rare, and the once-slow Chansey has grown much quicker on its feet. Catching one is said to bring good luck.
description.guide: A pink, egg-shaped Normal Pokémon that carries a nutritious egg in its belly pouch and shares eggs with the injured. It is female-only, rare in the wild and said to bring good luck. It evolves from Happiny, and into Blissey with high friendship.
description.tagline: A kind-hearted nurse with an egg to share

description.fun: Blissey can sense sadness through its fluffy fur and rushes to comfort anyone who's sad or unwell. Eating one of its eggs is said to make anyone kind and pleasant, calm even the fiercest Pokémon and bring good fortune. It looks a lot like a nurse, and its Japanese name, Happinas, blends 'happiness' and 'nurse'.
description.guide: The final stage of Happiny's line, introduced in Generation 2, a round, pink and white Normal Pokémon resembling a nurse. It senses sadness with its fur and cares for the sick, and its egg is said to bring happiness. It evolves from Chansey with high friendship.
description.tagline: A fluffy nurse whose eggs make everyone kinder

transitions.how: Level up, during the day, holding Oval Stone

note.text: Happiny is a baby Pokémon, added in Generation 4, three generations after the Chansey it grows into.
